epithelial reticular cells.

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the organ descriptions, the node figure, the drainage table, and the thymus/spleen sections; the USMLE question attack structure (stem patterns, traps, look-alike pivots, mini-case with distractors) is a KYP design.
kypExtensions.location: usmle section (patterns, traps, pivots, miniCase) + recall/rapidReview

kypExtensions.summary: Reading every lymphoid organ as a zoning problem: node zones (B-cortex / T-paracortex / macrophage-medulla) with clinical pairs per zone (DiGeorge underdeveloped paracortex; EBV paracortical hyperplasia), splenic white-pulp zones (PALS / follicle / marginal zone), and thymic cortex-medulla maturation gradient.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source describes each organ separately; unifying them under one zoning reading that maps structure to clinical consequence is KYP's integrative model.

kypExtensions.summary: The drainage map as one rule plus its exceptions: right lymphatic duct = right side above the diaphragm; thoracic duct = everything else (hence Virchow node, chylothorax); then the pectinate-line divider and pop-lateral foot rule for the pelvic/leg clusters.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source lists clusters and ducts in a table; compressing them into the territory rule with the two named eponym nodes is KYP's exam-retrieval structure.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + visual lymphatic-drainage-map callouts + miniCase reasoning + mnemonic 3

notes: REBUILT batch (the original E19 was destroyed un-pushed with 4c22047 in the 7th wipe). Evidence set is more comprehensive than the lost batch's 90 (this rebuild pins 122). Ligature fidelity (documented): the printed table uses fi U+FB01 in 'Superfi(cial) inguinal' and '(superfi(cial) inguinal)', and fl U+FB02 in 'Infl(ammatory) bowel disease' and 'splenic fl(exure)' x2 — quotes embed the ligature code points. The prose uses 1°/2° (degree sign) while the node figure labels use 1º/2º (masculine ordinal) — both quoted as printed. The neonatal thymus line uses curly quotes around sail-shaped. The involution line prints C1-control arrow glyphs (stripped by the normalizer) — spans are quoted to the arrow boundaries; the text layer renders 'coritsol' (as-is). Table row assignments verified against a 400-DPI render (three independent VLM reads agree): mediastinal row carries Pulmonary TB (unilateral hilar) and Sarcoidosis (bilateral hilar); hilar row carries Lung cancer and Granulomatous disease; the mesenteric and iliac/inguinal pathology cells are merged spans in print — documented in the note's table caption. Census: p116 carries 2 printed elements (histology micrograph + schematic) consolidated as sv1; p117 carries the body map + table (sv2/sv3); p118 carries the spleen diagram + neonatal CXR consolidated as sv4; histology/radiograph conveyed schematically, never reproduced (COPYRIGHTED_NO_REPUBLISH).
